title: Introducing a Family of Synthetic Datasets for Research on Bias in Machine Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It introduces a synthetic dataset to measure bias in machine learning, specifically focusing on age as a sensitive attribute in a credit scoring context.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the research.
